description: Where the current reading sits in its own recent distribution, from a series captured every ~10 minutes: funding, open interest, Fear & Greed and BTC dominance, each as current, median, min, max and percentile over the window. This is the one question a snapshot cannot answer — "is funding high right now?" has no absolute answer, only one relative to where it has been. A percentile near 0 means the reading is at the low end of the window, near 100 the high end. Check "samples" before trusting the percentile: a window with few measurements is not a distribution. Window defaults to 24 hours, maximum 168. Funding is in percent per 8 hours.

hours.description: How many hours back the window covers. Defaults to 24, maximum 168.
